channel.title: ZHANXIN GLOBAL - Engineering Notes
channel.description: Field notes on outdoor light boxes, wayfinding signage, bus shelters, LED/LCD displays and metal structures for export projects: materials, IP ratings, certification routes and container loading.

item.title: Gulf Conformity for Gulf Projects: SASO, SABER, ECAS and G-Mark Explained
item.description: Which Gulf scheme applies to your shipment, why consignment certificates differ from factory ones, and how to avoid containers waiting for paperwork.

item.title: CE Marking for Export into the EU: What Actually Happens, and Who Carries the Obligation
item.description: CE is a declaration you make, not a certificate you receive. Who holds the obligation, what the file must contain, and what delays shipments.

item.title: Airport Terminal Wayfinding: How to Plan Sign Structures That Still Work After Handover
item.description: How to specify terminal wayfinding that survives authority review and stays serviceable: legibility, fire class, modularity, airside maintenance.

item.title: LED or LCD? Choosing the Right Screen Technology for Outdoor and Semi-Outdoor Sites
item.description: Where large-format LED beats LCD outdoors and where it does not: size limits, sunlight damage, viewing distance, service life and running cost.

item.title: How Many Units Fit in a 20'GP? Loading Estimates for Light Boxes and Bus Shelters
item.description: Units per container is a function of unit size and packing volume, not a fixed number. How to estimate light box and bus shelter loading by dimension.

item.title: Outdoor LED Display Specification: Brightness, Pixel Pitch, Heat and Access
item.description: How to specify an outdoor LED screen: brightness in real sunlight, pixel pitch against viewing distance, thermal design and service access.

item.title: WPS, PQR and Welder Qualification: What Your RFQ Should Actually Ask For
item.description: WPS, PQR and welder qualification: what each one is, when it matters, and the variables to check before accepting welding documentation.

item.title: EN 10204 Material Certificates Explained: 2.1, 2.2, 3.1 and 3.2 Compared
item.description: What each EN 10204 inspection document proves, why type 3.1 is not third-party, and how to read one line by line before you accept it.

item.title: Smart Bus Shelter Specification Checklist: Every Option You Need to Decide Before Requesting a Quote
item.description: A complete configuration checklist for urban shelter procurement: structure, glazing, lighting, smart modules, power, compliance, packing and installation support.

item.title: Outdoor Light Box Materials: Aluminium Profile vs Galvanized Steel (and When Neither Is Right)
item.description: A practical material comparison for outdoor light boxes and display frames: strength, corrosion, weight, tooling economics and 10-year cost of ownership.

item.title: IP Ratings for Outdoor Displays and Enclosures: Choosing Between IP54, IP65, IP66 and IP67
item.description: How to read IEC 60529 ratings, why IP67 does not replace IP66, and how to specify enclosure protection for outdoor light boxes and LED screens.

item.title: EN 1090 Execution Classes EXC1 to EXC4: What Buyers Outside the EU Need to Know
item.description: How EN 1090 execution classes are determined, who decides them, and what EXC1 to EXC4 actually require from a metal fabricator exporting to the EU.
